text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P0 - gpu-prefill-oom on inference-prod-us-west-2-a. Multiple containers restarted, error rate spike. Pager routed to SRE oncall.
Sam L: seeing repeated container exits with CUDA OOM during prefill for requests with very large context windows (~300k tokens).
Morgan: logs?
Sam L: pastes logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z runtime: prefill_start id=abcd1234 model=rwkv-xxl seq_len=262144 prefill_tokens=198000
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z runtime: allocate failed: cudaMalloc 0x7f... size=24GB OOM
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z container: oom-kill exit_code=137, restarting
```
Jen P: which pool/stack? dedicated or hosted?
Sam L: hosted, gc1 nodes (A100-80GB). Pattern: long prompts from single customer and some noisy traffic generating long prefill. Not steady load, spikes.
Tariq: any hotfix attempted?
Sam L: tried increasing prefill memory cap and enabled prefix-KV eviction for one node, that reduced immediate failures but nodes still crash under heavy burst.
Morgan: can we throttle prefill window or reject >X tokens at gateway?
Jen P: yes, gateway can 413 on long contexts, but customers might see 4xx. Need a customer impact assessment before broad throttle.
CS Bot: Customer alpha-prod saw 18% error rate (500) for 12m starting 02:11 UTC, ticket INC-8271 created, CS pinged.
Kai: I'm taking handoff for rotation in 10. Current status?
Sam L: active mitigation: 1) cordon suspect node (gc1-04) 2) move new allocations to warm nodes with KV eviction enabled 3) enable short-term model-fallback rule to smaller quantized variant for requests >128k tokens.
Tariq: cordon + drain sounds good. Who will drain? I can run the drain command.
Sam L: please, run drain on gc1-04. Use `kubectl drain node/gc1-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` and remove from LB after drain.
Tariq: running drain now.
Sam L: also setting route-policy: `if prefill_tokens > 120000 -> route=rwkv-xxl-quant-small` for 30m.
Morgan: are we comfortable with quality drop? This is temporary. Notify product and CS.
Jen P: product okay for fallback for 30m if we limit to queries that would otherwise kill containers. CS to message impacted customer.
CS Bot: Notified alpha-prod that we're mitigating and expect reduced availability for very long contexts.
deploy-bot: applied route-policy change to inference-router-prod in 3s.
Sam L: confirm eviction settings on remaining nodes: `runtime.conf.kv_cache.max_prefill_memory=12GB`, `prefill_stream_trim=true`.
Kai: I will monitor node metrics and larger pools for next hour. If memory churn continues we should consider temporary autoscale of dedicated pool or increase eviction aggressiveness.
Tariq: drain completed, node gc1-04 cordoned and drained, pods rescheduled. Restarting inference runtime on targeted pods to pick up eviction config.
Sam L: after actions, error rate dropped from 18% to 2% in 6 minutes. Still seeing isolated restarts on older pods.
Morgan: can we identify the client IDs making 300k token requests? Need to consider long-term quota.
Sam L: pulling request logs. pattern: repeated prefill from api-key: ak_live_9xx, likely a batch import job.
Jen P: CS will ask customer to throttle or use streaming prefill. Add rate-limit policy for that key if they don't comply.
Kai: handing off monitoring to night oncall @Kai for next shift. If OOM resumes, escalate to infra lead and consider temporary global long-context reject.
Sam L: opened incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/6555551234 (will add timeline + metrics).
Tariq: opening hotfix PR to add safer default prefill caps to runtime config and stronger circuit-breaker for prefill allocation.
Morgan: good. Also log-level: capture `prefill_tokens` in trace to link to pod restarts.
Sam L: taking action items: (1) add quota rule for >200k tokens (temp), (2) patch runtime defaults, (3) postmortem with remediation (prefill throttling + better eviction heuristics).
CS Bot: Customer alpha-prod acknowledged update, will reduce their batch size.
Jen P: please coordinate follow-ups in postmortem. Assigning postmortem leads: Sam L (tech), Morgan (infra), Jen P (customer comms).
Kai: oncall note: I've set alert to fire at 3x baseline restart rate and doppler to page again.
Sam L: final status at handoff: mitigation active, error rate near baseline, no customer-facing degradation outside alpha-prod. Handoff to Kai for night watch.
Kai: acknowledged. I'll keep the thread updated if anything flares. :thumbsup:
